description: This file provides a helper function 'resolveAuthEndpointUrl' to determine whether a given API endpoint should route to an external domain or use the existing base URL. It includes logic to match specific auth-related endpoints and force their URLs to point externally, primarily for authentication flows that require bypassing internal proxies.

methods.name: resolveAuthEndpointUrl
methods.description: Resolves the full URL for a given API endpoint path, forcing certain auth endpoints to use an external domain.
